name: CASE-2026-041 — Customer Data Exposure
description: A formally opened incident case concerning a customer-document export configuration defect that exposed statement PDFs outside the intended account scope. The service was disabled and logs preserved. Initial Security assessment identified 120 potentially affected customers; Operations reconciliation identified 118 confirmed affected customers after removing two failed-download events. Reconciliation status remains pending. Case is owned by Incident Commander with workstreams assigned to CTO, Customer Service, DPO, Financial Crime, and CRO.
context: A customer-document export configuration defect exposed statement PDFs outside the intended account scope.
Initial Security assessment: 120 potentially affected customers. Operations reconciliation: 118 confirmed affected customers, after removing two failed-download events.
Workstream owners: CTO containment; Customer Service complaints; DPO privacy and holds; Financial Crime AML records; CRO governance reporting.

name: Security Initial Assessment — 120 Potentially Affected Customers
description: Initial impact assessment conducted by Security team identifying 120 potentially affected customers in connection with the customer-document export configuration defect. This assessment is in conflict with the Operations reconciliation count and reconciliation status is pending.
context: Initial Security assessment: 120 potentially affected customers

name: Operations Reconciliation Assessment — 118 Confirmed Affected Customers
description: Reconciliation assessment conducted by Operations team identifying 118 confirmed affected customers after removing two failed-download events from the initial Security count. This assessment conflicts with Security's initial count of 120 and reconciliation remains unresolved.
context: Operations reconciliation: 118 confirmed affected customers, after removing two failed-download events.
This is unresolved: do not replace one count with the other.

name: Service Disabled and Logs Preserved
description: Containment action taken in response to the customer-document export configuration defect. The affected service was disabled to prevent further exposure and system logs were preserved for forensic analysis.
context: The service was disabled and logs preserved.

name: Customer Data Exposure Complaint
description: Customer complaint related to the exposure of statement PDFs outside the intended account scope due to the customer-document export configuration defect. Complaints are being handled by the Customer Service workstream.
context: A customer-document export configuration defect exposed statement PDFs outside the intended account scope.
Workstream owners: CTO containment; Customer Service complaints

name: Data Retention and Privacy Hold Decision
description: Data protection and retention decision managed by the DPO workstream in connection with CASE-2026-041. The decision governs privacy holds and data retention obligations related to the customer data exposure incident.
